snippet.title: #AdvJam2017 #16: 03:17 am - Full Playthrough / Longplay / Walkthrough (no commentary)
snippet.description:
Full playthrough + all endings of 03:17 am, a short artful free-to-play interactive narrative, inspired by Edward Hopper's Nighthawks painting, made for #AdvJam2017. Recorded by Eric, published 16 June 2019.

.03:17 am endings:
13:03 Throw box away (good ending?)
14:56 Deliver box
16:30 Open box


.03:17 am release dates:
- Windows PC: 21 May 2017
- Mac OS X: 21 May 2017
